_notes: Canonical user story schema. This file is written by the user-story skill only. All downstream systems (mini app, Sheet export, PM tool push) read from this. Only the review app writes back to the status field on each story.

epics.name: Case Management & SLA
epics.description: Creation, lifecycle management, and SLA tracking for customer cases.

epics.name: Case Routing & Queue Management
epics.description: Rules and logic for routing cases to the right team or agent.

stories.title: As a Service Agent I want to create a case from an inbound email so that customer issues are automatically logged without manual entry
stories.i_want: create a case from an inbound email
stories.so_that: customer issues are automatically logged without manual entry
stories.description: When a customer sends an email to the support address, a case should be automatically created in Salesforce and assigned to the correct queue. The agent should be able to see the original email content within the case record.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Inbound emails to support@acme.com automatically create a new Case record
Case subject is populated from the email subject line
Original email is visible in the case email thread

acceptance_criteria.given: A customer sends an email to support@acme.com
acceptance_criteria.when: The email is received by Salesforce
acceptance_criteria.then: A Case is created with Status = New and assigned to the General Support queue

salesforce.notes: Standard Email-to-Case configuration. No custom dev expected.

stories.title: As a Service Agent I want to see the SLA countdown on a case so that I can prioritise my work before a breach occurs
stories.i_want: see the SLA countdown on a case
stories.so_that: I can prioritise my work before a breach occurs
stories.description: Each case must display the remaining time against the SLA milestone. Agents need a visual indicator when a case is approaching or has breached SLA.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Case record displays remaining time to first response SLA milestone
SLA indicator turns amber when less than 2 hours remain
SLA indicator turns red when breached

acceptance_criteria.given: A case has an active SLA milestone
acceptance_criteria.when: Less than 2 hours remain before breach
acceptance_criteria.then: The SLA indicator on the case record displays in amber and the assigned agent receives a bell notification

salesforce.notes: Standard entitlement process. Amber threshold of 2hrs needs confirming with client — not explicitly stated in source.
